title: Fixed-width format
description: How a document is written to, and read from, one or several files of fixed-width records: each column has a width, an alignment and a padding character (version 1).

files.description: The files of one document, at least one. Several files are matched by the document fields they share.

name.description: Name of the file, used to match the files given to the reader and in error messages.

columns.description: The columns of the record, one after the other: a line is exactly as long as their widths added up.

width.description: Number of characters of the column.

align.description: Side of the value; the padding fills the other side. Default: right for decimal and integer columns, left otherwise.

pad.description: Character that fills the column. A pad other than a space needs align: right. An empty value is always written as spaces, so that it cannot be read as zero.

impliedDecimals.description: Decimal columns with a scale only: write the digits without a decimal mark, the last scale digits being the decimals (2.50 with scale 2 is 250).

overflow.description: A value longer than the width: error (the default) or, for a string column only, truncate to the width.
